notes:
# Video stops when you close notes {window}
Closing a recording's notes window now stops its video. Before, the sound
kept playing.

# Back online sooner {refresh}
Open the lid and your phone remote reconnects in seconds. RecordLah now
notices the Mac has woken straight away.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Small fixes.

highlights.text: Closing a recording's notes window now stops its video. Before, the sound kept playing.
